priorityList: Use Avenging Wrath on cooldown, or allow Wake of Ashes to trigger it if the Radiant Glory talent is active.
Cast Execution Sentence immediately before using Wake of Ashes, provided the target will survive for the duration.
Cast Wake of Ashes on cooldown to generate Holy Power and enable the use of Hammer of Light.
Cast Hammer of Light as your highest priority finisher whenever it is available.
Cast Templar's Verdict as your primary Holy Power spender when at 5 Holy Power or to avoid overcapping.
Cast Divine Storm only when the Empyrean Power buff is active in single-target situations.
Cast Divine Toll on cooldown, ideally during Avenging Wrath windows.
Cast Blade of Justice whenever Art of War or Righteous Cause procs.
Cast Hammer of Wrath whenever available, especially during Avenging Wrath or against low-health targets.
Cast Blade of Justice to generate Holy Power.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power and maintain its damage-taken debuff on the target.
Use Templar Strike and Templar Slash (or Crusader Strike) as filler generators when other abilities are on cooldown.
Use offensive trinkets and combat potions during Avenging Wrath windows for maximum burst.
Use racial damage abilities, such as Fireblood or Light's Judgment, on cooldown during burst phases.
